name: Bezvalienne
source:
Bezvallienne, also known as "Bezvy," is a Venus angel who works as a conflict mediator and a diplomat in Keisiema.
There's also many couples who ask her for a session to try to fix their relationship.
She loves to help people and loves it when people are honest with their feelings and show affection.
